SHORT ANSWER: No, not in a way that is worth the L4 hours. Main at 77c63ad can run a two-seed T. rex stance certification attempt mechanically. The notebook, physics r10, policy interface r15, the six-heading gate and certification_seeds = 2 are all in place. But what it would train is main's committed stance recipe, not the LTSB recipe used in the r10 rounds. Main's recipe has never been trained on r10. On r9 the same reward failed the pad fore-aft bar in every run that was judged, and the cause sits in a reward term that r10 did not change. The only recipe with r10 evidence of passing, LTSB plus the phase critic, is on branches that were never merged. Physics r10 is already on main, and so is the phase critic (as a notebook switch). The stagger and CoP-band reward terms are not.

Labels: [M] = measured (file:line, or RL = run log line, /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-mesozoic-labs/aff94cce-91ba-5515-b81b-a9f018e73dc9/scratchpad/work/run_log.txt); [I] = inferred. Repository paths are on my clone at 77c63ad, which has since been deleted.

1. MAIN'S STANCE RECIPE TODAY
- Gate [M]: kind stance_quality_heading/v1 (stance.toml l.531). The budget is 12,000,000 steps (l.532). The gate rolls 40 episodes on seeds 3042-3081 at each heading (l.685) and needs a lower confidence bound of at least 0.80 (l.689). The pad fore-aft bar is 0.80 (l.772), with at most 1 hop-or-fall episode (l.823). The rails are 2260 (l.843) and a 0.60 statue ratio (l.940). certification_seeds = 2 (l.954), collapse reference 3766.6 (l.1037), statue constants measured on physics revision 10 (l.1060). A hop watch stops the run at 7M if the policy is still hopping (l.1078-1082).
- Reward [M]: the leg home-pose term has weight 0.5 and tolerance 0.10 (l.68, l.81) on the default keyframe reference (base_env.py l.279). Lateral lean defaults to weight 0 (base_env.py l.277). Stance width uses the settled reference, gated at step 200 (l.165, l.188). There is no stagger or CoP-band key, and no code for either term on main (git grep finds nothing).
- PPO [M]: stock PPO with no symmetry key; learning rate 3e-5, starting log_std -1.5 (l.391, l.466).
- Phase critic [M]: no critic_phase key in stance.toml. The notebook switch CRITIC_PHASE defaults to False (sb3_training.ipynb l.224). Setting it to True writes critic_phase = true into every node of the chain (l.428-433), which changes hyperparameters_sha256 (critic_phase.py l.52).
- Plant and digests [M]: physics revision 10, interface revision 15 (plant_versions.toml l.607-611; digest_snapshot.generated.txt l.201-204). Stance digests: task 533fff20..., gate d26c34e6..., PPO 9d1598a6... (l.382-384). The stage manifest says "no r10 seed yet (bar 2)" (stages.toml l.34).
- Evaluation and certification [M]:
  - Main evaluates every 50,000 steps (notebook l.694), 40 episodes each time (train_base.py l.190).
  - The in-training manager refuses this gate kind, so every run trains its full budget (stance.toml l.947-953).
  - After the stage, the certificate is rolled on the handoff checkpoint, robust_best_model first (curriculum/checkpoints.py l.108-122). That checkpoint is chosen by best mean minus 1.0 x std of evaluation reward, with no warm-up (checkpoints.py l.28-86).

2. HOW LTSB DIFFERS [M: git diff 06b1a8e..8737cd3, plus the branch's stance.toml header l.1-20]
- Reward and PPO changes:
  - Leg home-pose term at weight 1.0, tolerance 0.05, settled reference; lateral lean 0.25 with tolerance 0.015 m.
  - Mirror-symmetric PPO (kappa 0.3, sigma floor 0.01, mirrored critic).
  - Stagger penalty 0.30 with tolerance 0.045 m; CoP band at weight 0.30.
  - Collapse reference 4470.4 (the statue scores 703.8 more under LTSB).
- Screen-only cadence: an evaluation every 131,072 steps of 10 episodes; a checkpoint every 262,144 steps, all kept.
- Digests: task 1e5964b6..., PPO 054ab483...; the gate digest is unchanged.
- Code not on main: the stagger term (60c0c1f), the band term (740fc3f), the floor_contact module and the cadence keys (176af89); 22 files, +3,425 / -776 lines.
- The phase-critic branch (1dfe232) adds only the critic-phase code and the notebook switch on top of LTSB; it does not touch stance.toml.
- Main's later port of the phase critic differs from the branch's version (critic_phase.py and critic_phase_ppo.py, +168 / -19 lines).

3. HISTORY
Correction to the task's framing [M]: the stance5, stance6 and stance7 rounds, and the phase-critic round's OFF runs, all trained branch recipes (LTSB), not main's. The OFF runs are byte-for-byte copies of stance6 (RL 970-971), so they add no new sample.

Main's own recipe:
- r10 [M]: never trained. The records say so as of 2026-10-25 (NEXT_STEPS.md l.301-303; KNOWN_ISSUES.md l.335), and every T. rex stance launch since then names a branch (RL 666, 671-672, 885-887, 907, 911, 923).
- r9, same reward:
  - Run A 20261011_165957 [M]: 12M steps, 17 h 23 min. Its certificate checkpoint (robust_best, at 3.2M) was clean on only 1 of 40 episodes, failing the pad CoP bar on 39 of 40 (TREX_STANCE_SYMMETRY_AND_FOOT_2026_10.md l.303, l.336-344).
  - Short screens [M]: the 1M control put the pad on its toe edge on 5 of 5 seeds (l.496). The 3M control had 39, 37 and 37 of 40 episodes over the bar (l.498).
  - Diagnosis [M]: the committed reward pays for a forward lean of about 23 mm through its keyframe-centred leg term (KNOWN_ISSUES.md l.191-195). Run A's edge was not caused by the tail (TREX_TAIL_SATURATION_HABIT_2026_10.md l.565).
- r8 [M]:
  - 20261006_185343 was clean on 0/40 and 20261006_185704 on 13/40 (NEXT_STEPS.md l.256-257).
  - The D-D27 task runs: 0/40, 36/40, and 39/40 for seed 52. Seed 52 then scored 32/40 on fresh seeds and was ruled research-only (KNOWN_ISSUES.md ~l.143-152).
- Tail habit: never measured on main's recipe (critic_phase.py l.12-13) [M].

LTSB and the other branch recipes:
- r9 [M]: stance3 0 of 3 held, stance4 0 of 3, stance5 2 of 5 (tail-tip actuator pinned on s42 and s80) (KNOWN_ISSUES.md Updates 10 and 12; NEXT_STEPS.md l.527-552).
- stance6, r10, no phase critic [M]:
  - s42 pinned the tail actuator (RAIL) and failed the gate at its final checkpoint; s60 parked its tail; s80 had no tail habit but a saturated neck actuator (RL 711).
  - s80's certificate at 6.29M passed only 5 of 40 (stance6_results/review/REVIEW.txt l.437-446).
  - The K1-K4 checks: only s60 holds (RL 991).
- stance7, r10, with the phase critic [M]:
  - No tail rail or parked tail in 3 of 3 runs, and the gate certificate 40/40 at the final checkpoint in 3 of 3, "measured on a screen task; not certification" (RL 968).
  - K1-K4 hold in 3 of 3 (RL 991).
  - The pre-registered test read NOT SEPARATED (RL 968).
  - The do-nothing statue passes the same gate, and the runs beat its 4470.4 reward by only +8.9 to +17.2 (ANSWER.md l.6, l.17).
- The notebook's own end-of-stage verdict in stance6 [M]: it judged robust_best checkpoints at 0.9-2.0M and passed all three runs, including s42, whose final checkpoint fails (REVIEW.txt l.440-448; check1/NOTES.txt l.94-96).

4. WHAT TWO SEEDS ON MAIN TODAY WOULD LIKELY GIVE [I]
- The certificate most likely fails on the pad fore-aft bar for most seeds; 2 of 2 passing is unlikely. Reasons:
  - The same reward failed every judged r9 run.
  - The cause is a reward term.
  - r10 changed only the tail-spring preloads; masses, geometry and actuators are the same (plant_versions.toml l.550-559 [M]).
- Points that cut the other way:
  - On r10 the statue's pads sit nearer their centre (worst CoP 0.322, against 0.475 on r9; plant_versions.toml l.583-584 [M]). Whether trained policies follow is untested.
  - The certificate judges robust_best. In the r9 1M probes it was a near-statue checkpoint at 50k-350k steps (34-39/40 clean); in Run A it was the edge policy (stance record l.449-451 [M]). So an early near-statue checkpoint could pass, but it would certify standing, not quality: the statue itself is clean on 40/40 at every heading (stance.toml l.652-653 [M]).
- Turning CRITIC_PHASE on is untested on main's recipe. It targets the tail habit, not the forward lean, so it is not expected to fix the known failure.

5. WHAT HAS TO LAND ON MAIN FIRST
- (a) A recipe with r10 evidence, meaning the LTSB terms:
  - Config only, since the code is already on main: the settled leg reference at 1.0/0.05, lateral lean 0.25/0.015, and mirror-symmetric PPO.
  - New code: the stagger and CoP-band terms and the floor_contact module.
  - Re-measured statue constants: the collapse reference about 4470.4 (measured on the branch), and the reward rail re-derived as 0.60 x statue, about 2680 [I]. The branch kept 2260.
  - A regenerated digest snapshot.
  - A recovery re-measure, because recovery inherits the stance [env] and [ppo] tables (stance.toml l.5, l.390 [M]).
- (b) The phase critic on for the stance:
  - Either set CRITIC_PHASE = True on both seeds (and again on any resume), or commit critic_phase = true in stance.toml. Committing it would also switch it on in recovery, which reads a different settle step (S = 140) [I].
  - Evidence, on LTSB only: 3 of 3 runs free of the habit against 1 of 3 without, and K1-K4 holding 3 of 3 against 1 of 3. Not confirmatory.
- (c) Physics r10: already on main, nothing to land [M].
- (d) Worth ruling on before any attempt:
  - The certificate judges the reward-selected robust_best checkpoint, which cannot see a habit that forms late in training.
  - Whether a screen run could ever count toward certification if its configuration were later committed byte-for-byte is an open question for you (stance record l.1692-1695 [M]; the recommendation there was no).
- A cheap check first, if you would rather keep main's recipe [I]: a 1M-step CPU probe of main's recipe on r10. The r9 equivalent cost about 39 min per run on 4 CPUs (run_a/report.md l.190 [M]), and it would show whether the toe edge comes back.

6. L4 HOURS PER SEED
- Main's recipe at main's evaluation schedule: about 17-18 L4-hours per seed, about 35 for two [I]. The basis [M]:
  - The two r8 runs of the then-committed recipe took 14 h 55 min and 15 h 46 min for 11.0M steps (NEXT_STEPS.md l.256-257); the stance.toml note gives L4 timing for them (l.1076-1077).
  - Run A took 17 h 23 min for 12M; its hardware is not recorded in what I read.
  - The end-of-stage certificate and bundle took about 47 min after training (RL 693, 697).
- LTSB on the screen schedule, measured from launch to the run's manifest file:
  - stance6: 14.9 h and 15.0 h (RL 666, 693, 697) [M].
  - PHASE runs: 14.5, 14.6 and 15.2 h (RL 885-887, 912, 917, 929) [M].
  - OFF runs: 14.9, 15.0 and 14.7 h, 44.6 L4-hours for three (PC_REPORT.md l.280) [M].
  - So the phase critic adds no measurable time [M].
- LTSB on main's evaluation schedule would likely take about 17-18 h [I]. Main evaluates 40 episodes every 50k steps, about 9.6M evaluation steps, against the screen's 91 x 10 episodes.
- The earlier review estimated 30-60 L4-hours and about a week for certifying on main (handoff final/NEXT_STEPS.md l.177; ANSWER.md l.43) [M].

read:cert.answer:
SHORT ANSWER. The certification machinery on main is fully built and wired: one notebook run with BEHAVIOR="stance" on the T. rex trains the stance, rolls the six-heading certificate, writes gate_verdict.json and records a seed-replication count in the result bundle. But main is NOT set up to certify the recipe the walking pilots' parent came from (LTSB + phase critic). Main would only certify its own committed stance recipe. That recipe has never trained on physics r10, and its one recorded r9 run failed the gate. The "band" is not a missing piece of the certification path itself. It is a missing piece of the recipe (the reward), and that is why branch certificates do not count on main.

1. WHAT "CERTIFIED" MEANS ON MAIN (measured unless marked)
- Gate. The T. rex stance declares gate_kind = "stance_quality_heading/v1", the six-heading certificate of D-D32 (configs/tyrannosaurus_rex/anatomical/stance.toml:531; BEHAVIOR_RECIPES_PLAN.md:1316).
  - Seeds 3042-3081 are rolled at -90, -45, 0, 45, 90 and 180 degrees, each against the statue rolled at that heading.
  - Every heading must pass the stance_quality/v2 decision (D-D23, BEHAVIOR_RECIPES_PLAN.md:1307).
  - The bound on seeds clean at every heading must reach 0.80 at 40 seeds, so 37/40 passes and 36/40 fails (stance.toml:685-692; GQ-7 at GAIT_QUALITY_PLAN_2026_09.md:189).
- Per run. A node is certified when its own gate_verdict.json passed and every warm_start_from ancestor passed (docs/RESULT_BUNDLES.md:23-26).
  - The verdict comes only from stance_heading_report.json bound to the handoff pair and re-derived from its rows (reporting/gates.py:1724-1729).
  - There is no fallback to the yaw-zero panel.
- Two-seed bar. certification_seeds = 2 (stance.toml:954-965; D-B9 and BEHAVIOR_RECIPES_PLAN.md:604-662).
  - The bundle records deliverables.stance = {certified, replication {count, runs}, certification_seeds, provisional = count < 2} (reporting/bundles.py:621-631).
  - A replicate is a sibling run in the same logs/tyrannosaurus_rex/anatomical/ppo/ folder, on a different seed, with a passed verdict and equal task_sha256, gate_sha256, plant identity and hyperparameters_sha256 (replication.py:3-15; RESULT_BUNDLES.md:294-332).
  - Precedent: the r13 stance was counted "certified true, provisional false, replication count 2" (NEXT_STEPS.md:288-293).
- Policy rules in the docs:
  - Two seeds, each judged on 3042-3081 and re-judged on the fresh seeds 7042-7081, before any recovery, walk or hunt (D-D27 at BEHAVIOR_RECIPES_PLAN.md:1311; NEXT_STEPS.md:355-359 and 411-414; HEADING_INVARIANCE_DESIGN_2026_10.md:540-543).
  - A certified T. rex stance on two seeds before any T. rex walk (GAIT_QUALITY_PLAN_2026_09.md:700, the section 12 note on GQ-17).
  - Screens certify nothing (NEXT_STEPS.md:626-628, among others).
  - Current state: "no r10 seed yet (bar 2)" (configs/tyrannosaurus_rex/anatomical/stages.toml:34).
- What is not the stance certificate:
  - behavior_certification.py is the direction/terrain skill certificate. It is "distinct from canonical curriculum certification" (behavior_certification.py:3) and uses configs/behavior_certification.toml.
  - A row in results/offline_judgements.csv "certifies no run" (results/README.md:94), and it has no r10 rows.
  - There is no records/ directory and no registry of certified checkpoints under configs/.

2. THE PATH ON MAIN TODAY (sb3_training.ipynb)
- Settings:
  - REPO_REF "main" (ipynb:49).
  - SPECIES "tyrannosaurus_rex" (the default is velociraptor, ipynb:175); EMBODIMENT "anatomical"; ALGORITHM "ppo".
  - BEHAVIOR "stance" (the default is "hunt", ipynb:199). This resolves to the single root node stance; I ran this through the code.
  - A different SEED per run (ipynb:188), a new RUN_ID per run (ipynb:203), QUICK_TEST False (ipynb:190; quick tests are never replicates), USE_GOOGLE_DRIVE True.
  - TRUNK_FROM does not matter: the target node is never reused across runs.
  - CRITIC_PHASE False, which is main's committed recipe (ipynb:224).
  - K3_PANEL is report-only and enters no digest.
  - There is no CERTIFY flag: grep for CERTIFY in the notebook finds nothing. Every trained node is judged automatically.
- What the run does:
  - Trains 12,000,000 steps (stance.toml:532). The hop watch stops a seed still hopping at 7M; such a seed is restarted on a new seed.
  - Then generate_stage_artifacts (ipynb:1428) rolls the certificate on the selected handoff pair (stage_artifacts.py:281-293 and 446-505), about 13 minutes.
  - It writes 01_stance/stance_heading_report.{txt,json}, stance_heading_panel_selected.csv and gate_verdict.json.
  - Then save_run_bundle (ipynb:1447) writes provenance.json, summary.json, collected_results.csv, with artifact_manifest.json last, plus the replication record.
- I ran 140 tests of the replication and heading-gate code on the clone (test_replication, test_stance_heading_gate, test_gate_dispatch_fail_closed, test_stance_heading_judge): all passed, rc 0.
- After the runs: a second seed run in the same folder and the 7042 fresh audit with stance_gate_report.py --seed 7042 --out-dir <scratch> (stance_gate_report.py:44-52). Then, by convention (inferred, nothing in code requires it), a docs PR updating NEXT_STEPS section 2, stages.toml:34 and KNOWN_ISSUES, plus offline_judgements rows.

3. HOW THE BAND RELATES
- The gate is the same on main and on the branch:

verify.answer:
READY WITH CAVEATS. The certification machinery on main works. The problem is the recipe. A run launched today would certify main's own committed stance recipe, not the LTSB + phase-critic recipe behind the walking pilots' parent, and on the record that run would most likely fail [inferred]. [M] = measured, [I] = inferred; evidence is in the findings.

(1) WHAT A RUN IS TODAY [M]
- Notebook settings in sb3_training.ipynb:
  - REPO_REF: set it to the commit SHA you launch from (the field takes a commit, ipynb:80-81), so both seeds share every digest.
  - SPECIES tyrannosaurus_rex, EMBODIMENT anatomical, ALGORITHM ppo.
  - BEHAVIOR "stance". NEXT_STEPS still says "stand", which the notebook refuses.
  - QUICK_TEST False, Drive on.
  - CRITIC_PHASE the same on both seeds: False is main's recipe (digest 9d1598a6), True gives 1a83fd10.
  - A different SEED and a new, explicit RUN_ID for each seed. RUN_ID "" re-enters the last run when only SEED changes.
- There is no certify switch. Each run trains 12M steps (the hop watch can stop a seed at 7M), then rolls the six-heading certificate on robust_best_model (about 13 min) and writes gate_verdict.json and the result bundle. The second seed's bundle records replication 2, which clears the provisional label.
- After both runs, by hand:
  - Run the fresh-seed audit on each handoff: stance_gate_report.py --seed 7042 --out-dir <scratch>. D-D27 requires it; seed 52 once passed 39/40 on the main seeds, then got 32/40 on the fresh ones and was ruled research-only.
  - Open a docs PR updating stages.toml:34, NEXT_STEPS, KNOWN_ISSUES and offline_judgements.
- I re-ran 227 tests at 77c63ad (gate, replication, reuse and critic-phase code): all pass.

(2) WHAT WOULD MAKE IT FAIL OR MISLEAD, RANKED
- (a) Main's recipe has never trained on physics r10, and its r9 record is bad [M]. Its [env]/[ppo] tables match the 2026-10-12 ones except one re-measured threshold.
  - On r9 that reward put the pad on its toe edge in 5/5 seeds at 1M, and 37-39 of 40 episodes were over the bar at 3M.
  - Run A (r9, the older observation interface r13) was clean on 1/40 at 12M.
  - The cause is a reward term, and r10 changed only the tail springs.
- (b) The recipe with r10 evidence cannot run on main [M]: the stagger and CoP-band reward code is not there (task digest 533fff20 on main against 1e5964b6 on the branch).
- (c) A pass can be shallow [M]. The certificate judges robust_best, which has no warm-up. In stance6 it picked checkpoints at 0.9-2.0M and passed s42, whose final checkpoint fails. The zero-action statue also passes 40/40.
- (d) Operational traps:
  - Seeds with a different CRITIC_PHASE or code revision do not count as replicates [M].
  - Two seeds that finish together each record a count of 1; one bundle then has to be re-saved by hand [I].

(3) SHORTEST PATH TO A RUN WORTH LAUNCHING
- A. Main's recipe, no code PR:
  - You approve a 1M-step CPU probe of the recipe on r10, about 40 min per seed (the plan's estimate).
  - Only if the pad stays off its toe edge, launch two L4 seeds: about 17-18 L4-hours each, about 35 in all [I].
  - Then the two fresh-seed audits and the docs PR.
- B. LTSB + phase critic:
  - A code PR: port the stagger and CoP-band terms and the floor_contact module (the branch diff is 22 files, +3,425/-776); add the stance.toml keys and mirror_kl; re-measure the collapse reference and rail; regenerate the digest snapshot; re-measure recovery; write a decision record.
  - Your approval, then two seeds at 15-18 L4-hours each, with CRITIC_PHASE True on both.
  - Rule on the three screen runs first. Main's code re-derives their task and recipe digests exactly, their plant identity matches main's in every field, and they sit in the same Drive folder. A byte-identical landing would let the code count s42/s60/s80 automatically [I]. The stance record recommends they do not count.

(4) STILL UNCERTAIN
- Whether r10's better-centred statue pads (worst CoP 0.322 against 0.475 on r9) change the outcome for main's recipe.
- How long main's evaluation cadence takes on an L4.
- Whether GitHub main has moved past 77c63ad (no network here).
- Whether the phase critic helps main's recipe (never tested).
- Whether a 1M probe predicts the result at 12M.
